lines.zh: 它迈着僵硬而均匀的步子
lines.en: It walks in stiff, even strides.

lines.zh: 金属脚掌碾过碎石
lines.en: Metal feet grind over gravel.

lines.zh: 关节每动一下都咔一声
lines.en: Every joint clicks as it moves.

lines.zh: 它沿着直线逼近，不绕路
lines.en: It closes in a straight line, never detouring.

lines.zh: 双臂垂下，随时能抬起
lines.en: Arms hang low, ready to come up.

lines.zh: 它的脚步把灌木压平
lines.en: Its tread flattens the brush.

lines.zh: 头盔里的红光左右扫描
lines.en: A red glow sweeps inside its visor.

lines.zh: 它走得慢，但从不迟疑
lines.en: Slow, but it never wavers.

lines.zh: 每一步落点都像量过
lines.en: Every footfall looks measured.

lines.zh: 铁壳摩擦，发出低哑的响
lines.en: Its plating rasps against itself.

lines.zh: 它从树影里稳步走出来
lines.en: It steps steadily out of the shade.

lines.zh: 沉重的声音先到，人才到
lines.en: The heavy sound arrives before it does.

lines.zh: 机器人站着，内部嗡嗡作响
lines.en: The robot stands, humming inside.

lines.zh: 它的头缓慢转向一侧
lines.en: Its head turns slowly to one side.

lines.zh: 胸口的散热口喷出白气
lines.en: Vents at its chest puff white.

lines.zh: 指节一节节张开又握紧
lines.en: Its fingers open and close in sequence.

lines.zh: 它静止时也保持着战斗姿势
lines.en: Even at rest it holds a fighting stance.

lines.zh: 天线微微震颤，在接收什么
lines.en: An antenna quivers, receiving something.

lines.zh: 它的液压管轻轻泄压
lines.en: A hydraulic line bleeds pressure.

lines.zh: 面罩后的光暗了一下又亮
lines.en: The light behind its visor dims and returns.

lines.zh: 它抬起一只手检查关节
lines.en: It lifts a hand to check a joint.

lines.zh: 地面被它的重量压出浅痕
lines.en: Its weight leaves shallow dents.

lines.zh: 它无声地站着，像一尊铁像
lines.en: It stands silent as an iron idol.

lines.zh: 它的处理器发出细密的滴声
lines.en: Its processor emits tiny ticks.

lines.zh: 它把拳头对着空气试了试
lines.en: It tests a fist against empty air.

lines.zh: 肩膀的装甲自己复位了
lines.en: A shoulder plate clicks back into place.

lines.zh: 面罩的红光对准了你
lines.en: The red visor locks onto you.

lines.zh: 它把你从头到脚扫了一遍
lines.en: It scans you from head to foot.

lines.zh: 机器发出一声确认的短鸣
lines.en: The machine gives a confirming chirp.

lines.zh: 它在计算你身上的武器
lines.en: It is counting the weapons on you.

lines.zh: 它歪头，像在读取什么
lines.en: It tilts its head as if reading.

lines.zh: 它的拳慢慢收紧
lines.en: Its fists slowly close.

lines.zh: 它没有表情，只有光
lines.en: No expression, only light.

lines.zh: 它朝你迈近半步，试探
lines.en: It steps half a pace closer to test.

lines.zh: 它抬起手臂，显示尺寸
lines.en: It raises an arm, showing its size.

lines.zh: 一声低鸣，像警告也像记录
lines.en: A low tone, warning or recording.

lines.zh: 它把你归类为战斗目标
lines.en: It files you under combat targets.

lines.zh: 它不退，也不闪，只是看着
lines.en: It neither retreats nor flinches.

lines.zh: 它用铁指点了点你的方向
lines.en: An iron finger points your way.

lines.zh: 它把你和影像里的敌人比对
lines.en: It compares you to an image in memory.

lines.zh: 它抬起下巴，像在宣战
lines.en: It lifts its chin like a challenge.

lines.zh: 它的关节预热，咔咔作响
lines.en: Joints warm up with a rattle.

lines.zh: 它记住你的位置，纹丝不动
lines.en: It logs your position and holds still.

lines.zh: 它对你没有兴趣，只有任务
lines.en: It has no interest in you, only orders.

lines.zh: 装甲被砸出凹陷，火花四溅
lines.en: A dent sprays sparks off its armour.

lines.zh: 它后退半步，重新校正姿态
lines.en: It backs half a step and re-levels.

lines.zh: 机体的蜂鸣变尖了
lines.en: Its internal hum turns shrill.

lines.zh: 它检查受损部位，动作很快
lines.en: It checks the damage fast.

lines.zh: 破口处冒出细细的青烟
lines.en: Thin smoke curls from the breach.

lines.zh: 它的一条臂线卡了一下
lines.en: One arm's motion stutters.

lines.zh: 它低声报出一串错误码
lines.en: It mutters a string of error codes.

lines.zh: 装甲碎片落在地上叮当响
lines.en: Fragments clatter onto the ground.

lines.zh: 它把损伤区隔离开
lines.en: It isolates the damaged section.

lines.zh: 但它仍未停止计算
lines.en: And still it keeps calculating.

lines.zh: 机器人扫了一眼你手里的东西
lines.en: The robot flicks a scan over your hands.

lines.zh: 它对食物没反应，对金属有
lines.en: Food means nothing; metal does.

lines.zh: 它伸手，掌心朝上，像索要
lines.en: It extends an open palm, demanding.

lines.zh: 能量信号让它靠近了一步
lines.en: An energy signature draws it a step near.

lines.zh: 它把物品夹起来仔细扫描
lines.en: It picks the item up and scans it.

lines.zh: 它发出满意的短促蜂鸣
lines.en: It emits a satisfied short beep.

lines.zh: 它把东西收进胸腔的舱口
lines.en: It stows the thing in a chest hatch.

lines.zh: 它看着你的手，等你再给
lines.en: It watches your hand for more.

lines.zh: 它把没用的东西丢回地上
lines.en: What it cannot use, it drops.

lines.zh: 它对你的诱饵只是静静注视
lines.en: It just stares at your bait.

lines.zh: 你撞上机器人，像撞铁门
lines.en: You hit it like a slammed iron door.

lines.zh: 它的装甲纹丝不动
lines.en: Its plating does not budge.

lines.zh: 你被反弹得倒退两步
lines.en: You rebound two steps backward.

lines.zh: 它侧身让开，动作很省
lines.en: It steps aside with minimal motion.

lines.zh: 铁臂擦过你的肩，留下凉意
lines.en: An iron arm grazes your shoulder, cold.

lines.zh: 它伸手把你推开半米
lines.en: It pushes you back half a metre.

lines.zh: 两具铁壳相碰，声音刺耳
lines.en: Two metal shells clash shrilly.

lines.zh: 它的脚压住你的影子
lines.en: Its foot pins your shadow.

lines.zh: 它低头确认没有损伤
lines.en: It looks down to confirm no damage.

lines.zh: 它连一步都没被撞偏
lines.en: Not one step off line.

lines.zh: 两台机体互相交换信号
lines.en: Two units trade signals.

lines.zh: 它们的面罩光同步闪动
lines.en: Their visor lights blink in sync.

lines.zh: 它们并肩站立，姿势一致
lines.en: They stand abreast in identical pose.

lines.zh: 数据线在两者之间接通
lines.en: A data link connects them.

lines.zh: 它们对望，像在核对编号
lines.en: They face each other, checking IDs.

lines.zh: 机械臂交叠，卡得严丝合缝
lines.en: Their arms overlap, perfectly fitted.

lines.zh: 它们同时转头，朝向同一处
lines.en: Both turn toward the same point.

lines.zh: 蜂鸣声一长一短，像应答
lines.en: Beeps answer back and forth.

lines.zh: 它们的散热孔一起喷气
lines.en: Their vents exhale together.

lines.zh: 两台机器进入了同一套节奏
lines.en: The two settle into one rhythm.

lines.zh: 机器人弯腰拾起金属块
lines.en: It stoops and picks up the metal.

lines.zh: 它把零件举到眼前扫描
lines.en: It holds the part up to scan.

lines.zh: 它把战利品塞进背部卡槽
lines.en: It slots the prize into its back.

lines.zh: 它捏了捏，判断材质
lines.en: It squeezes, judging the material.

lines.zh: 它把不合适的丢到一边
lines.en: Unsuitable pieces are tossed aside.

lines.zh: 它收集弹壳，动作很熟练
lines.en: It gathers spent casings with practice.

lines.zh: 它把东西码放得整整齐齐
lines.en: It stacks the items neatly.

lines.zh: 它用指尖夹起，一点不抖
lines.en: It pinches the item up without a tremor.

lines.zh: 它把东西压进胸口，锁好
lines.en: It presses the item in and locks it.

lines.zh: 拾取完毕，它立刻转回目标
lines.en: Collection done, it turns back at once.

lines.zh: 机器人的面罩全红了
lines.en: The visor floods full red.

lines.zh: 它的头猛地锁定你
lines.en: Its head snaps onto you.

lines.zh: 一声长长的启动音响起
lines.en: A long activation tone sounds.

lines.zh: 它的肩甲弹开，露出散热口
lines.en: Shoulder plates flare open to vent.

lines.zh: 关节全部绷紧，准备启动
lines.en: Every joint tightens for launch.

lines.zh: 它抬起双臂，摆出战斗架势
lines.en: It lifts both arms into a guard.

lines.zh: 地面被它踩出一个小坑
lines.en: It grinds a small pit underfoot.

lines.zh: 它把身体重心压低半寸
lines.en: It drops its centre of mass.

lines.zh: 光学传感器缩成一点
lines.en: Its optics narrow to a point.

lines.zh: 它报出你的方位，像在记录
lines.en: It recites your bearing like a log entry.

lines.zh: 它开始数你的呼吸
lines.en: It starts counting your breaths.

lines.zh: 机器的嗡鸣升高了一个调
lines.en: The hum climbs a full tone.

lines.zh: 它选定最短的攻击路线
lines.en: It selects the shortest attack line.

lines.zh: 两侧的装甲已经锁死
lines.en: Side plates have locked down.

lines.zh: 它发出最后一次警告音
lines.en: It sounds one final warning.

lines.zh: 倒计时结束，它动了
lines.en: The countdown ends, and it moves.

lines.zh: 机器人跟着你平移
lines.en: The robot tracks you sideways.

lines.zh: 它一步一停，测算距离
lines.en: Step, pause, recalculate.

lines.zh: 它抬起手臂，对着你的胸口
lines.en: It raises an arm at your chest.

lines.zh: 它在等你进它的射程
lines.en: It waits for you to enter its range.

lines.zh: 红光一直停在你身上
lines.en: The red light stays on you.

lines.zh: 它试着从右侧切入
lines.en: It probes an approach on your right.

lines.zh: 它的伺服马达低低作响
lines.en: Motors whine low and steady.

lines.zh: 你换位，它立刻修正方向
lines.en: You move; it corrects instantly.

lines.zh: 它把退路用脚步封住
lines.en: It seals your exits with its stride.

lines.zh: 它突然静下来，是因为瞄准
lines.en: Its sudden stillness is aiming.

lines.zh: 它握拳，关节发出锁死声
lines.en: A fist locks with a hard click.

lines.zh: 它不浪费一次动作
lines.en: It wastes no motion at all.

lines.zh: 它反复比对攻击角度
lines.en: It recalculates the strike angle.

lines.zh: 警告音短促地响了两下
lines.en: Two short warning beeps.

lines.zh: 它把你逼向背后的岩壁
lines.en: It herds you toward the rock wall.

lines.zh: 它的影子压在你身上
lines.en: Its shadow settles over you.

lines.zh: 机器从不为恐惧停顿
lines.en: The machine never pauses for fear.

lines.zh: 它已经算到了三步之后
lines.en: It is already three moves ahead.

lines.zh: 机器人的铁拳砸在你护甲上
lines.en: Its iron fist slams your armour.

lines.zh: 它一记横扫，把你打退
lines.en: A sweep of its arm knocks you back.

lines.zh: 第二拳紧接第一拳
lines.en: A second fist follows the first.

lines.zh: 合金肩甲撞过来，很沉。
lines.en: The alloy shoulder plate hits heavy.

lines.zh: 它抓住你，往地上砸
lines.en: It grabs you and drives you down.

lines.zh: 铁掌拍下，地面裂开细纹
lines.en: A metal palm cracks the ground.

lines.zh: 它抬膝，撞向你的腹部
lines.en: It drives a knee into your middle.

lines.zh: 它出拳时几乎没有任何预兆
lines.en: Its punch comes with no warning.

lines.zh: 拳风把你的头发压向后
lines.en: The punch wind flattens your hair back.

lines.zh: 它一击落空，立刻收势
lines.en: It misses and recovers at once.

lines.zh: 它让你撞上树干，再松手
lines.en: It slams you into a trunk, then lets go.

lines.zh: 连续的打击没有间断
lines.en: The blows do not pause between them.

lines.zh: 它盯着你脚步，专打下盘
lines.en: It eyes your feet and strikes low.

lines.zh: 这一击，它用了全部输出
lines.en: That one carried its full output.

lines.zh: 它收回拳头，等下一次机会
lines.en: It pulls the fist back for the next opening.

lines.zh: 关节过热的蒸汽喷出来
lines.en: Overspent steam jets from its joints.

lines.zh: 远处先响起金属的脚步声
lines.en: Metal footsteps ring out from afar.

lines.zh: 一具高大的机体走进视野
lines.en: A tall frame walks into view.

lines.zh: 它的面罩在暗处亮起红光
lines.en: A red visor lights in the dark.

lines.zh: 树叶被它的肩甲刮得直响
lines.en: Leaves rasp on its shoulder plates.

lines.zh: 它停在空地边缘，扫描四周
lines.en: It halts at the clearing edge to scan.

lines.zh: 启动音从低处一路升上来
lines.en: The startup tone rises from a rumble.

lines.zh: 它的关节一节节舒展开
lines.en: Its joints unfold segment by segment.

lines.zh: 落地的冲击震起一圈尘
lines.en: Its landing kicks up a ring of dust.

lines.zh: 它在泥地上留下深深的脚印
lines.en: Deep prints mark the mud behind it.

lines.zh: 它没有来由，也没有犹豫
lines.en: It arrives without reason or hesitation.

lines.zh: 一台战争机器已经到场
lines.en: A war machine has entered the field.

lines.zh: 它的头部转向你的方向
lines.en: Its head turns toward where you are.

lines.zh: 装甲板自动合拢，发出脆响
lines.en: Plates close up with a crisp snap.

lines.zh: 它把地面踩得陷了半寸
lines.en: It sinks half an inch into the soil.

lines.zh: 背后喷出一股热风
lines.en: A gust of hot air blasts from behind it.

lines.zh: 它带来一股机油与金属味
lines.en: It brings a smell of oil and metal.

lines.zh: 一具沉默的铁影立在那里
lines.en: A silent iron shape stands there.

lines.zh: 它抬起手，指向你的方向
lines.en: It raises a hand toward you.

lines.zh: 高温让它的外漆起泡剥落
lines.en: Heat blisters and peels its paint.

lines.zh: 落地时它一只腿的缓冲失效
lines.en: Its leg damper fails on landing.

lines.zh: 进水后它短路的噼啪声很密
lines.en: Water shorts it out in a crackle.

lines.zh: 冲击波把它掀得横滑出去
lines.en: The shockwave skids it sideways.

lines.zh: 弹丸嵌进装甲，卡住了关节
lines.en: A round lodges in its armour and jams a joint.

lines.zh: 奇异能量穿透外壳，元件乱鸣
lines.en: Strange energy pierces it; components screech.

lines.zh: 能量见底，它的动作开始迟滞
lines.en: Low on power, its motion drags.

lines.zh: 雷击顺着外壳走，指示灯全灭
lines.en: The bolt crawls the hull; lights go out.

lines.zh: 虚空撕扯它，金属发出哀鸣
lines.en: The void wrenches it; the metal groans.
